findings.title: A/HEAVY: inherited-key rule can taint every unlabeled session
findings.body: N4 promises that an unlabeled record changes no ledger verdict, but N7 checks inherited properties on an ordinary gate extract. If Object.prototype acquires task_notification, every extract reads as tainted even when no record has the label or an own gate key. Newly counted clean sessions would then be refused as trusted. This is a conditional in-process prototype-pollution scenario; no pollution source was established in this review.
findings.recommendation: Make produced gate extracts immune to global prototype pollution, for example with a null prototype, and test an unlabeled session while Object.prototype carries task_notification. Apply the round-3 STOP CRITERION before revising Table N.

next_steps: Resolve the N4/N7 conflict under the pinned round-3 criterion before dispatch.
